newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-LEANEY HOLDS ON TO LEAD IN TITLE DEFENCE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-LEANEY HOLDS ON TO LEAD IN TITLE DEFENCE.

text.p: Australian Stephen Leaney maintained his grip on the Victorian Open by taking a two-shot lead after the third round on Saturday.
Leaney, the defending champion, has led from the first round and fired a level par 72 to finish on eight under par for an aggregate score of 208 at the Victorian course.
He leads from compatriots Euan Walters, Darren Cole and amateur Geoff Ogilvy.
Leaney led by six strokes after an eagle and a birdie in the first four holes to be 11 under but three dropped shots brought him back towards the chasing pack.
